root: ^Sofia glances toward the town, her eyes dark with thought before she speaks.
^This place… Oppidum. It was built only a few years ago, but it carries more history than it should. She gestures around, her voice even.

^A town like this should thrive. We have a skilled blacksmith, a reliable merchant, a librarian, an apothecary… And yet, people vanish. People die. The ground here is stained with stories that refuse to be forgotten.

^Some say it's cursed. That the town was never meant to exist. That something watches us. I don’t believe in superstitions, but I can’t ignore the patterns. Sheila’s death… isn’t the first. And if we don’t stop this cycle, it won’t be the last.
